segments.sn22.26:1.2: “Pubbeva [pubbe (pī. ka.)] me, bhikkhave, sambodhā anabhisambuddhassa bodhisattasseva [bodhisattassa (pī. ka.)] sato etadahosi –
segments.sn22.26:1.3: ‘ko nu kho rūpassa assādo, ko ādīnavo, kiṃ nissaraṇaṃ?
segments.sn22.26:1.4: Ko vedanāya assādo, ko ādīnavo, kiṃ nissaraṇaṃ?
segments.sn22.26:1.5: Ko saññāya assādo, ko ādīnavo, kiṃ nissaraṇaṃ?
segments.sn22.26:1.6: Ko saṅkhārānaṃ assādo, ko ādīnavo, kiṃ nissaraṇaṃ?
segments.sn22.26:1.7: Ko viññāṇassa assādo, ko ādīnavo, kiṃ nissaraṇan’ti?
segments.sn22.26:1.9: ‘yaṃ kho rūpaṃ paṭicca uppajjati sukhaṃ somanassaṃ, ayaṃ rūpassa assādo.
segments.sn22.26:1.10: Yaṃ rūpaṃ aniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ, ayaṃ rūpassa ādīnavo.
segments.sn22.26:1.11: Yo rūpasmiṃ chandarāgavinayo chandarāgappahānaṃ, idaṃ rūpassa nissaraṇaṃ.
segments.sn22.26:1.12: Yaṃ vedanaṃ paṭicca uppajjati sukhaṃ somanassaṃ, ayaṃ vedanāya assādo [yā (ka.)].
segments.sn22.26:1.13: Yaṃ vedanā aniccā dukkhā vipariṇāmadhammā, ayaṃ vedanāya ādīnavo.
segments.sn22.26:1.14: Yo vedanāya chandarāgavinayo chandarāgappahānaṃ, idaṃ vedanāya nissaraṇaṃ.
segments.sn22.26:1.15: Yaṃ saññaṃ paṭicca uppajjati … pe … yaṃ saṅkhāre paṭicca uppajjati sukhaṃ somanassaṃ, ayaṃ saṅkhārānaṃ assādo.
segments.sn22.26:1.17: Yaṃ [ye (sī. ka.)] saṅkhārā aniccā dukkhā vipariṇāmadhammā, ayaṃ saṅkhārānaṃ ādīnavo.
segments.sn22.26:1.18: Yo saṅkhāresu chandarāgavinayo chandarāgappahānaṃ, idaṃ saṅkhārānaṃ nissaraṇaṃ.
segments.sn22.26:1.19: Yaṃ viññāṇaṃ paṭicca uppajjati sukhaṃ somanassaṃ, ayaṃ viññāṇassa assādo.
segments.sn22.26:1.20: Yaṃ viññāṇaṃ aniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ, ayaṃ viññāṇassa ādīnavo.
segments.sn22.26:1.21: Yo viññāṇasmiṃ chandarāgavinayo chandarāgappahānaṃ, idaṃ viññāṇassa nissaraṇaṃ’”.
segments.sn22.26:2.1: “Yāvakīvañcāhaṃ, bhikkhave, imesaṃ pañcannaṃ upādānakkhandhānaṃ evaṃ assādañca assādato ādīnavañca ādīnavato nissaraṇañca nissaraṇato yathābhūtaṃ nābbhaññāsiṃ, neva tāvāhaṃ, bhikkhave, sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambuddhoti paccaññāsiṃ [abhisambuddho (sī.)].
segments.sn22.26:2.2: Yato ca khvāhaṃ, bhikkhave, imesaṃ pañcannaṃ upādānakkhandhānaṃ evaṃ assādañca assādato ādīnavañca ādīnavato nissaraṇañca nissaraṇato yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ;
segments.sn22.26:2.3: athāhaṃ, bhikkhave, sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambuddhoti paccaññāsiṃ.
segments.sn22.26:2.5: ‘akuppā me vimutti [cetovimutti (sī. pī. ka.)]; ayamantimā jāti; natthi dāni punabbhavo’”ti.

lines: Paṭipāṭiyā panettha pañcamachaṭṭhasattamesu cattāri saccāni kathitāni, aṭṭhamanavamesu vaṭṭavivaṭṭaṃ.
25-30. Dhātusaṃyutte vuttanayeneva veditabbāni, kevalañhi ettha khandhavasena desanā āgatā, tattha dhātuvasenāti ayameva viseso.
